note: P4392 (Pro 31:17) — she dresses herself with strength and makes her arms strong.

dims.v: vigour — the energetic strength she brings to her work
the dressing of herself with strength and making her arms strong — the energetic vigour she brings to her labour, girding herself for work as for a task worth her full power, strength put to purpose
the purposeful vigour that girds itself for its labour

amats (be strong/strengthen) — 'she dresses herself with STRENGTH and makes her arms strong' (31:17); she brings energetic vigour to her work, girding herself for labour. Strength willingly spent in purposeful industry is part of her excellence.
